application_type_full: Householder planning & demolition in a conservation area
description:
1) Demolition and like-for-like rebuilding of the existing front bay window, due to structural defects
2) Demolition and like-for-like rebuilding of the existing first floor outrigger and associated walls below, due to structural defects
3) New Bicycle and Bin Store Along With Upgrades to Front Boundary Wall
decision_conditions:
The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this permission.


REASON: In order to comply with the provisions of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended).

The Development hereby permitted shall only be carried out and completed strictly in accordance with the submitted plans hereby approved and any subsequent approval of details.


REASON: To ensure that the development hereby permitted is carried out in full accordance with the plans hereby approved.

<p>The rear outrigger which is required to be demolished and rebuilt shall be carefully dismantled by hand (not using power tools) taking care not to damage the bricks and the bricks shall be set aside for re-use. The outrigger shall be rebuilt re-using the set aside bricks (with any new bricks being reclaimed bricks, entirely cleaned of paint, soot and any other coatings before reuse). All new brickwork shall match the original brickwork in respect of colour, texture, face bond and pointing (unless the existing pointing is inappropriate).</p><p>REASON: To preserve the character and appearance of the Conservation Area in accordance with Section 72 of the Planning (Listed Buildings and Conservation Areas) Act 1990 and Hackney Local Plan 2033, Policies LP1 Design Quality and Local Character, and LP3 Designated Heritage Assets.</p>

<p>All new works, and works of making good to the retained fabric, relating to the development and the works hereby approved shall match the existing bay window and outrigger in respect of the materials used, detailed execution and finished appearance including the material, dimensions, composition, form, colour, finish and profile, and in the case of brickwork, facebond and pointing, unless shown otherwise on the drawings or other documentation hereby approved or required by any condition(s) attached to this consent. The works shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with the approved details.</p><p>REASON: To preserve the character and appearance of the Conservation Area in accordance with Section 72 of the Planning (Listed Buildings and Conservation Areas) Act 1990 and Hackney Local Plan 2033, Policies LP1 Design Quality and Local Character, and LP3 Designated Heritage Assets.</p>
